g.text: Matter Review: EPC Balance of Plant Agreement
Matter Ref: #MAT-2026-EPC-084 · Governing Law: Indian Arbitration & Conciliation Act
📜 Contract Clause 18.4 · Consequential Damages & LD Waiver
"Neither party shall be liable for indirect or consequential damages. Liquidated damages for delayed
commissioning shall not exceed ten percent (10%) of the Contract Price, provided the delay is not excused
by Employer default, unseasonal grid curtailment, or Force Majeure under Clause 22."
Q: Does grid curtailment on 22 May relieve contractor liability under Clause 22?
Yes. Substation SCADA log #SC-892 confirms 400kV bus was tripped by SLDC. Covered under Clause 22.3(a).
